newsitem.title: ITALY: Include Bible in summer reading list, Pope says.
newsitem.headline: Include Bible in summer reading list, Pope says.

text.p: Pope John Paul on Sunday invited Roman Catholics taking off for summer holidays to pack not only the latest bestseller, but also a copy of the Bible.

"The frenetic rhythm of life maybe often prevents many from getting close to the Bible as they would like. Why not take advantage of the holidays to read one or two of its immortal pages?" John Paul said during his weekly Angelus address.
The 77-year-old Pontiff returned on Saturday from a 10-day mountain holiday in the Val D'Aosta region on the French border.
He is now at his summer residence in Castelgandolfo, south of Rome.
